audit.why: 54.12% over 85 games. Cassiopeia owns everything up to first item and Kayle takes 2+ items — that is exactly what both layers say, and it is the standard shape of a scaling-versus-lane-bully matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and Kayle's ultimate — the single cooldown that decides every all-in — had no number.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1. That is one invulnerability every two and a half minutes, so 'she has no defensive button until her own R' becomes actionable only once the reader knows how long the window after it lasts. Radiant Blast is 12s at rank 1 and Celestial Blessing 15s.
audit.corrected: 160s written into content.spikes[1].text, content.mid, full.breakdown.cooldowns and full.loading; 12s and 15s into full.breakdown.cooldowns and full.report[8].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet is right that the page never named a single Kayle ability. Worse, content.mid and content.whys[3] leaned on Miasma 'grounding her if she ever buys a way to disengage' — Kayle has no dash, so the page's anti-mobility plan pointed at nothing.
audit.why: Riot: Celestial Blessing 'heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally' — a move speed buff, not a movement ability, so what actually stops her walking out is Miasma's slow, not its grounding. Radiant Blast slows and reduces resistances at 900 range; Starfire Spellblade is an attack reset that scales with missing health; Divine Ascent is what gives her attack range as she levels.
audit.corrected: Divine Ascent, Radiant Blast, Celestial Blessing, Starfire Spellblade and Divine Judgment are now all named, and the grounding claim is replaced by Miasma's slow versus Celestial Blessing's speed in content.mid and content.whys[3].

audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a 15-second heal on a lane opponent you beat by grinding HP off her — Grievous Wounds is what stops her undoing a won trade on the walk back to the wave.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early, content.mid and content.late were written in the first person ('I have only one ability', 'This is my takeover window'), and the full layer called Kayle 'he'.
audit.why: Every other matchup on the site addresses the reader as 'you'. A first-person block reads like someone else's diary in the middle of a coaching page.
audit.corrected: All three prose blocks converted to second person; full.tldr, full.report[0].t, full.dosFull[1].t and full.dontsFull[0].t degendered.

edits.before: Once you have Q+E you prime with Noxious Blast and chain Twin Fangs — Kayle is still melee with no dash and no escape, so every poison tick is free damage she cannot answer.
edits.after: Once you have Q+E you prime with Noxious Blast and chain Twin Fang — Kayle is melee with no dash, and Celestial Blessing's 15-second heal cannot out-pace your poison ticks.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze turns a won trade into a kill — she has no defensive button until her own R, so all-in here while she is still vulnerable.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze turns a won trade into a kill — Divine Judgment is 160 seconds at rank 1, so every all-in you take while it is down is nearly free.

edits.before: Kayle is one of the most meleed laners in the game — no ranged form until 6, no dash, and squishy. At level 1 I have only one ability and no poison-stacking yet, so I last-hit with the tail of Noxious Blast and do not overcommit. The moment I have Q and E at level 2 I prime her with poison and chain Twin Fang resets — she literally cannot run because Noxious Blast hands me free move speed on champion hit and she has no escape. Every percent of HP I take here is HP she needs to survive to her scaling.
edits.after: Kayle is one of the most melee-locked laners in the game — Divine Ascent gives her no attack range until 6, she has no dash, and she is squishy. At level 1 you have one ability and no poison stacking, so last-hit with the tail of Noxious Blast and do not overcommit. The moment you have Q and E at level 2, prime her with poison and chain Twin Fang — she cannot run, because Noxious Blast hands you free move speed on champion hit and she has no escape. Every percent of HP you take is HP she needs to reach her scaling.

edits.before: This is my takeover window and the whole matchup hinges on it. Ranks in Q and E let me chain near-continuous Twin Fangs while my passive move speed keeps me glued to a still-melee Kayle, and Miasma grounds her if she ever buys a way to disengage. At level 6, Petrifying Gaze answers any jungle dive and turns my won trades into kills — and crucially she has no defensive button until her own R is up, so I want every all-in before her ult is reliable. Shove waves, deny her CS, and force her to recall on low HP before she even reaches ranged form.
edits.after: This is your takeover window and the matchup hinges on it. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fang while your passive move speed keeps you glued to a still-melee Kayle, and Miasma's slow cancels the move speed Celestial Blessing hands her when she tries to walk out. At 6, Petrifying Gaze answers any jungle dive and turns won trades into kills — and Divine Judgment is 160 seconds at rank 1, so once she burns it you own the next two and a half minutes outright. Shove waves, deny her CS, and force a low-HP recall before she reaches ranged form.

edits.before: Be honest: Kayle wins late and there is no kiting this. Once she becomes ranged at 6 and fully online with Exalted waves and two items, she out-ranges my ~700-unit poison zone and never has to walk into Miasma, her waveclear shoves me in, and her R invulnerability simply turns off my Twin Fang DPS at the exact moment I commit. I stay squishy with no resistances. So the entire plan is to end before that — snowball lane, take her tower, and group to close on a timer. If the game goes long, she is the carry and I am not.
edits.after: Be honest: Kayle wins late and there is no kiting this. Once Divine Ascent makes her ranged and two items land, she out-ranges your 700-unit Twin Fang and never has to walk into Miasma, her waveclear shoves you in, and Divine Judgment's invulnerability turns your DPS off at the exact moment you commit. You stay squishy with no resistances, and Radiant Blast strips what little you have. So the plan is to end before that — snowball lane, take her tower, and group to close on a timer. If the game goes long, she is the carry and you are not.

edits.after: Ranks in Q and E chain Twin Fang all trade long, and Miasma's slow cancels the Celestial Blessing speed she walks out on — you own a melee Kayle.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — one invulnerability every two and a half minutes, so commit the moment it is spent. - Radiant Blast is 12s at rank 1 and strips your resistances. - Miasma is 24s: hold it to slow her out of Celestial Blessing's speed.

edits.before: Track Kayle’s Divine Judgment (Invuln): Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Radiant Blast slows and shreds resistances at 900 range. Starfire Spellblade resets her attack — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

notes: Deliberately did not assert anything about whether Petrifying Gaze's stun still applies to a Kayle inside Divine Judgment's invulnerability. Riot's text says invulnerable, which speaks to damage, and the kit file's needsResearch block is empty on purpose — it is not evidence of a ruling either way. That is a genuinely useful thing for the page to say and I could not verify it from the kits, so it is in unverified.
